summary: Bring existing video code or footage into HyperFrames and verify it frame by frame against the original - Remotion first, also Motion Canvas, Lottie, Three.js, p5.js, canvas or plain HTML/CSS animation, or renders from Manim, After Effects or Blender. Use to port, convert, migrate or reuse work…
verification: Write what didn't translate cleanly (dropped volume ramps, approximated presentations, substituted fonts) to TRANSLATION_NOTES.md.
whenToUse: For transitions Remotion presets that have visually-rich GLSL equivalents (iris, ripple, zoom, glitch), use HF's shader-transitions package.
They produce richer output than manual GSAP transforms.
